Go SDK {{ds:component/chip|label=v2|variant=primary}}

A typed client for the v2 REST API, for Go 1.19+.

Install

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=go get github.com/godzilla-io/godzilla-go}}

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=main.go|language=go|code=pipeline, err := client.Pipelines.Create(ctx, &godzilla.CreatePipelineRequest{ Name: "ingest-orders", SourceConnectorID: "conn_pg_orders", DestinationConnectorID: "conn_snowflake_dw", })}}

Publishing events

Send events to pipelines using the client:

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=main.go|language=go|code=event, err := client.Events.Publish(ctx, "pipeline_id", &godzilla.PublishEventRequest{ Data: []byte(`{"order_id": 123}`), })}} {{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Context support|body_html=

}}
